newsitem.title: UK: Grand Met slips after 6 pct profit rise.
newsitem.headline: Grand Met slips after 6 pct profit rise.

text.p: Shares in British food and drinks giant Grand Metropolitan were lower on Thursday after annual results came in slightly below the consensus of analysts' forecasts, traders said.
The shares fell 5p to 451-1/2p by 0852 GMT.

"There is no major problem with the results, but they are a touch below the consensus," said one trader. Full year pretax profits stood at 965 million stg, up from 920 million stg a year ago but below the average forecast of 972 million stg.
Analysts had forecast profits between 948-999 million stg.
The dividend was raised to 15.9 pence from 14.9 pence previously, slightly above the 15.8 pence most analysts were expecting.
Chairman George Bull said in a statement that current year trading had started satisfactorily.
